candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség – Tagjaink (member institutions directory)
candidates.why_relevant: Curated register of ~67 Hungarian credit institutions, mortgage banks, guarantee funds plus associated members/observers (Társult tagok, Megfigyelők). Each entry links to a per-member detail page (tagreszlet.cshtml?tagId=N) carrying the institution's own site — the single best seed for enumerating every bank-level disclosure/IR source in HU.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Static HTML scrape of the index plus each tagreszlet.cshtml?tagId=N detail page; snapshot quarterly and diff to detect membership churn (entries/exits, mergers).
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language search on association name + site navigation fetch
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség tagok listája éves jelentés bankszektor

candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség – Jelentések (annual and quarterly sector reports)
candidates.why_relevant: Association's own annual (évi beszámoló, 2001–2018 series) and quarterly (Q1–Q4 jelentés) sector reports plus 'Egyszerűsített Éves Beszámoló' 2023–2025, all as PDFs under /Public/jelentesek/. Gives sector-level narrative and aggregate banking results between MNB statistical releases.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Harvest PDF links from the index page; parse PDFs for sector aggregates. Note the numbered annual series appears to stop at 2018 — verify whether later years moved to Kommunikék/Publikációk.
candidates.discovered_via_method: site navigation fetch from association homepage
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség tagok listája éves jelentés bankszektor

candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség – Kommunikék (periodic sector communiqués)
candidates.why_relevant: Recurring communiqués summarising banking-sector developments and association positions; effectively the continuation channel for periodic sector commentary and the association's stance on regulation, fees and payments policy.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the archive listing monthly; fetch item pages/PDFs.
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség tagok listája éves jelentés bankszektor

candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség – Sajtóközlemények (press releases)
candidates.why_relevant: Association press-release archive; fastest signal on sector-wide positions (interest-rate caps, transaction levy, instant payments, cash/ATM obligations) that precede individual bank disclosures.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly HTML scrape of the listing; no RSS observed, so use listing diffing.
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség tagok listája éves jelentés bankszektor

candidates.source_name: Gazdaság és Pénzügy (G&P) – Bankszövetség academic journal
candidates.why_relevant: Peer-reviewed journal published by the association; carries data-rich articles on Hungarian bank profitability, digitalisation, payments and consolidation — often the only public quantitative treatment of niche topics (e.g. branch/ATM economics, cash logistics).
candidates.legal_status: public, articles copyrighted — cite, do not redistribute
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Per-issue PDF harvest; index titles/abstracts for topical retrieval.
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség tagok listája éves jelentés bankszektor

candidates.source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség – Munkacsoportok (working groups)
candidates.why_relevant: Working-group structure reveals which topics the sector is actively organising around (payments, digitalisation, compliance/AML, lending) and typically names the member banks and individuals leading each — a map of decision-makers and of live sector agenda items.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off scrape, refresh semi-annually; treat named individuals as personal data and store minimally.
queries_used: Magyar Bankszövetség tagok listája éves jelentés bankszektor

candidates.source_name: Hungarian Banking Association – English-language site
candidates.why_relevant: The .cshtml?lang=eng parameter serves an English mirror of the association pages, giving translated member names and report titles usable for cross-language entity resolution against EBF-level sources.
candidates.access_status: open (lang parameter inferred from hu URLs, EN coverage depth unverified)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the same paths with lang=eng; expect partial coverage — do not assume parity with the Hungarian tree.
candidates.discovered_via_method: URL-pattern inference from observed lang=hun parameter
queries_used: Hungarian Banking Association annual report members list English

candidates.source_name: Magyar Fintech Szövetség (HFA) – Tagok (member companies)
candidates.why_relevant: The only curated register of the Hungarian fintech ecosystem (startups through mature vendors, incubators, accelerators). Founding/board members observed include Barion, Tőkeportál, BlockBen, Ergománia, Bankmonitor, BÁV Faktor, Blueopes, Flexibill, Péntech, TechTeamer. Seeds dozens of PSP/vendor sources no keyword search surfaces.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the member grid (may be JS-rendered — fall back to rendered-DOM fetch); diff quarterly. Pair with /hu/riport/ for their published reports.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language search then homepage navigation fetch
queries_used: Magyar Fintech Szövetség tagvállalatok lista

candidates.source_name: Magyar Fintech Szövetség – Riport (association reports / fintech ecosystem mapping)
candidates.why_relevant: Association-published reports and ecosystem maps of Hungarian fintech; the closest thing to a sector yearbook for non-bank payment and fintech players, which otherwise publish no consolidated results.
candidates.access_status: open (some reports may require an email/registration gate — unverified)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/scripted PDF download per report; check for gating before automating.
queries_used: Magyar Fintech Szövetség tagvállalatok lista

candidates.source_name: Budapest Fintech Week – conference programme and exhibitor/speaker list
candidates.why_relevant: The association's flagship annual event (next observed edition 1–4 December 2026) plus monthly Meetups and Business Breakfast Talks. Speaker/sponsor/exhibitor rosters are a live indicator of which vendors are actively selling into Hungarian banks — a competitor-detection channel that member lists lag behind.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Snapshot the event page ahead of and after each edition; extract sponsor tiers and speaker affiliations.
queries_used: Magyar Fintech Szövetség tagvállalatok lista

candidates.source_name: Magyar Lízingszövetség – Lízingszövetségi statisztikák
candidates.why_relevant: Association-compiled leasing market statistics with an archive reported back to 2000, broken down by asset class (vehicles, real estate, equipment) and by member company. The authoritative HU leasing-volume series; ~36 member companies financing >HUF 1,300bn of assets.
candidates.access_status: open (some tables may be member-only — unverified)
candidates.legal_status: public; attribute the association as compiler
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly harvest of statistics files (XLS/PDF); build a time series keyed by member company and asset class.
queries_used: Magyar Lízingszövetség éves statisztika tagok beszámoló lizingszovetseg.hu

candidates.source_name: Magyar Lízingszövetség – Éves beszámoló (annual report)
candidates.why_relevant: The leasing association's own annual report — sector narrative plus, typically, the member roster and full-year volumes. Companion channels: sajtóközlemény, tagi hírek (member news), infografikák.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF pull; also poll /hirek?kategoriak=sajtokozlemeny and ?kategoriak=tagi-hirek monthly.
queries_used: Magyar Lízingszövetség éves statisztika tagok beszámoló lizingszovetseg.hu

candidates.source_name: Magyar Lízingszövetség – Tudásbázis (Eurotax reports, Datahouse data, ismertetők)
candidates.why_relevant: Knowledge base republishing third-party market datasets (Eurotax vehicle-valuation reports, Datahouse registration data) alongside the association's own explainers. A cheap route to commercial datasets that are otherwise paywalled at source.
candidates.legal_status: third-party datasets — check Eurotax/Datahouse licensing before redistribution; internal analysis only
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Category-filtered scrape (?kategoriak=eurotax-riportok, =datahouse); store links rather than redistributing licensed PDFs.
queries_used: Magyar Lízingszövetség éves statisztika tagok beszámoló lizingszovetseg.hu

candidates.source_name: GVH – Keresés versenyhivatali döntésekben (competition decision search)
candidates.why_relevant: Full-text searchable archive of Hungarian Competition Authority decisions covering 1997–2026, filterable by keyword, date range, decision number and party (eljárás alá vont). Bank/PSP merger clearances and consumer-protection cases contain market-share, pricing and product detail that appears in no other public source.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Standing queries on 'eljárás alá vont' entities drawn from the Bankszövetség/Lízingszövetség/HFA member lists; also crawl the per-year indexes (/dontesek/versenyhivatali_dontesek/dontesek-2026). Search is dynamic — a rendered-DOM or API-level fetch may be needed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language search then direct fetch of the search interface
queries_used: GVH versenyhivatal banki fúzió határozat közlemény döntések adatbázis

candidates.source_name: GVH – Összefonódások / Fúziók (merger control guidance and case practice)
candidates.why_relevant: Merger-control landing page for professional users; the entry point for tracking bank/leasing/PSP consolidation filings. Paired with GVH közlemények (e.g. 8/2017 as amended by 2/2018 and 3/2020 on conditions and obligations in non-prohibitive merger decisions), it explains how remedies are framed in HU banking deals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Watch the page and /szakmai_felhasznaloknak/kozlemenyek for new or amended közlemények; alert on new banking-sector filings.
queries_used: GVH versenyhivatal banki fúzió határozat közlemény döntések adatbázis

candidates.source_name: GVH – Beszámoló az Országgyűlés részére (annual report to Parliament)
candidates.why_relevant: GVH's statutory annual report to Parliament reviews the year's cases sector by sector; historically includes banking-sector merger reviews (e.g. the 1997 Bank Austria/CA case). A compact retrospective index of competition activity in financial services.
candidates.access_status: open (exact index path inferred from an observed PDF under /gvh/orszaggyulesi_beszamolok/ — treat the landing URL as unverified)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF pull; locate the current index via site search if the inferred path 404s.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language search result (observed PDF) + path inference
queries_used: GVH versenyhivatal banki fúzió határozat közlemény döntések adatbázis

candidates.source_name: IVSZ – Digitális Vállalkozások Szövetsége (fintech working group and member base)
candidates.why_relevant: IVSZ is the ICT/digital-business association; its Fintech Munkacsoport publishes trend positions on the fintech and banking sector, and its rolling 'új tagok' announcements enumerate technology vendors (CRM, cybersecurity, insurtech brokers, customer-service digitalisation) entering the market — precisely the supplier-side competitor set that bank-only member lists miss.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll /hirek for 'új tag' announcements monthly and extract company names; scrape the member directory and /szervezet/ for tagozat structure.
queries_used: IVSZ tagvállalatok lista digitális szövetség fintech

candidates.source_name: AmCham Hungary – Membership Directory (financial services members)
candidates.why_relevant: Bilingual member directory with per-company profile pages for banks operating in Hungary (OTP Bank, K&H Bank, ING Bank N.V. Hungary Branch, Deutsche Bank Hungarian Branch observed). Adds branch-office and foreign-parent entities that domestic associations under-represent, and AmCham committees/Board pages map senior financial-sector executives.
candidates.access_status: open (directory index path inferred from observed per-company URLs)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /membership/membership-directory/<slug> profile pages; cross-join with the Bankszövetség roster to isolate foreign-branch actors. Also snapshot /about-us/board-of-directors.
candidates.discovered_via_method: en-language search then URL-pattern inference from observed profile pages
queries_used: AmCham Hungary Financial Services Committee members bank

candidates.source_name: Magyar Faktoring Szövetség – Statisztikák
candidates.why_relevant: Quarterly and annual factoring-market statistics (series observed from 2019 to 2026; e.g. Q1 2025 financing volume >HUF 486bn, +28–41% y/y). Factoring volumes are a leading indicator of SME credit demand and of non-bank working-capital competition against banks.
candidates.access_status: open; note a legacy static tree also exists at http://www.faktoringszovetseg.hu/html/statisztika.html
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape of the statistics listing plus the legacy /html/ path for pre-2019 history; parse XLS/PDF into a volume series.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language search; snowballed from the leasing/receivables adjacency
queries_used: Magyar Faktoring Szövetség tagok statisztika; Magyar Követeléskezelők és Üzleti Információt Szolgáltatók Szövetsége tagok

candidates.source_name: MAKISZ – Magyar Követeléskezelők és Üzleti Információt Szolgáltatók Szövetsége
candidates.why_relevant: Debt-purchase and business-information association; ~41 members reported purchasing ~HUF 320bn of receivables (2020) and managing ~HUF 500bn. Enumerates the receivables-management and credit-bureau vendor set that sits downstream of every bank and leasing house, and runs sector conferences (e.g. on leasing-portfolio collections).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape the member page and news/conference listings; refresh semi-annually.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language search on the full Hungarian association name

candidates.source_name: MABISZ – Magyar Biztosítók Évkönyve (Hungarian Insurers' Yearbook) and member list
candidates.why_relevant: The clearest example in HU of a true association yearbook: annual 'Magyar Biztosítók Évkönyve' PDFs (2024, 2025 editions observed) carrying market data plus the member roster on a dedicated page — 32 members (26 insurers, 3 branches, 3 associations) per the 2024 edition. candidates.access_status: open — yearbook PDFs served directly from /wp-content/uploads/
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual yearbook PDF pull (WordPress uploads path is stable); parse the member-list page (~p.47 in the 2024 edition) into an entity table.
candidates.discovered_via_method: hu-language search; adjacency snowball from the banking association

candidates.why_relevant: ~70 members (28 full, 32 associate, 10 individual) categorised by role, incl. an /tagok/category/investors view. Identifies the capital behind Hungarian fintechs and the PE/VC owners that drive consolidation among payment and lending firms; the 30-year jubilee yearbook adds historical deal context.
candidates.access_status: open (both /tagok and /hu/tagok paths observed in results)

negative_findings.description: Searched for an AmCham Hungary financial-services committee roster in English. Results returned only individual member company profile pages (OTP, K&H, ING branch, Deutsche Bank branch) and the general Board of Directors page; no committee membership page surfaced.
negative_findings.result_summary: Committee-level membership for AmCham's financial services work is not visible in search results; only company-level directory entries and the Board page were found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Committee rosters would name the specific executives shaping the sector agenda; without them, AmCham is usable as a company register but not as a decision-maker map.

negative_findings.description: The Magyar Bankszövetség /jelentesek page shows numbered annual reports for 2001–2018 and quarterly reports for 2011–2018, while separate 'Egyszerűsített Éves Beszámoló' filings exist for 2023–2025. No 2019–2022 annual sector report was observed on that page.
negative_findings.result_summary: An apparent gap in the association's published annual/quarterly sector report series after 2018; recent years are represented only by simplified statutory accounts.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If the periodic sector report genuinely stopped, sector-level narrative for 2019+ must be reconstructed from Kommunikék, Publikációk and press releases instead — a materially different collection design.

negative_findings.description: The Magyar Fintech Szövetség (MAFISZ/HFA) member roster at hunfintech.com/hu/tagok/ was identified as the correct URL via site navigation, but the enumerated list of member companies was not returned in the fetched content — only founding members (Bankmonitor, Barion, BÁV Faktor, Blueopes, Flexibill, Péntech, Rocketsheperd, Tőkeportál, TechTeamer, dr. Vida Mariann Ügyvédi Iroda, MKB Fintechlab as supporting member) and current board affiliations (Ergománia, Tőkeportál, HOLD Alapkezelő, Barion, BlockBen) were observable.
negative_findings.result_summary: Member page located but roster content not extracted in this pass; likely JS-rendered.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is the highest-value fintech register in the cell; a rendered-DOM fetch is needed before the ecosystem can be enumerated.

negative_findings.description: Across the hu-language searches run for this cell, no distinct Hungarian payment-service-provider or acquirer association (an equivalent of a 'Magyar Pénzforgalmi Szövetség' or a PSP/e-money trade body) surfaced. Payments interests appear to be represented inside the Magyar Bankszövetség, the Magyar Fintech Szövetség and IVSZ's fintech working group instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: No standalone HU payments/acquiring trade association identified; function is distributed across banking, fintech and ICT associations.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Analysts should not keep searching for a single payments-association register — the equivalent coverage must be assembled from three association member lists plus MNB payment-institution registers (outside this cell).

negative_findings.description: MKIK (Magyar Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara) and BKIK (Budapesti Kereskedelmi és Iparkamara) were in the cell brief as 'Hungarian chambers' but were not searched in this pass; only the American chamber (AmCham) was covered.
negative_findings.result_summary: National and Budapest chamber member registers remain unexplored.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: MKIK/BKIK hold a statutory-registration-adjacent company base far larger than any sector association, including small financial intermediaries that no sector association captures.

negative_findings.description: Several association statistics and knowledge-base areas (Lízingszövetség tudásbázis Eurotax/Datahouse categories, HFA riport, Leaseurope statistics) plausibly sit behind member or email gates, but no gate was actually encountered in this pass because the underlying files were not fetched.
negative_findings.result_summary: Access status for the deepest data layers of several association sites is unverified — recorded as open with a caveat rather than as blocked.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design and licensing review depend on whether these are freely redistributable; assuming open access could create a licensing exposure for third-party datasets (Eurotax, Datahouse).

coverage_gaps.description: Hungarian chambers of commerce (MKIK national, BKIK Budapest) and their financial/economic sections were not covered; likewise other foreign bilateral chambers with financial committees (German-Hungarian DUIHK, British, French chambers).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run hu-language searches on 'MKIK tagnyilvántartás', 'BKIK tagjaink pénzügyi osztály', 'DUIHK Mitgliederverzeichnis Bank' and scrape the resulting directories.

coverage_gaps.description: The two highest-value registers in the cell — hunfintech.com/hu/tagok/ and ivsz.hu's member directory — were located but not enumerated, most likely because the listings are JavaScript-rendered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Re-fetch both with a headless-browser / rendered-DOM collector and materialise the member entities into the actor table; then seed one downstream disclosure source per member.

coverage_gaps.description: No search was run for the cooperative-credit and specialist-lender bodies (e.g. takarékszövetkezeti integráció, building-society/lakástakarék bodies, Magyar Követeléskezelők adjacents already partly covered), nor for the Hungarian Association of Investment Fund and Asset Management Companies (BAMOSZ) or the Budapest Stock Exchange issuer community.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend with hu queries: 'BAMOSZ tagok listája', 'takarékszövetkezeti integráció tagintézmények', 'lakástakarékpénztár szövetség'.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language coverage in this cell leaned on supranational bodies (EBF, Leaseurope, EPC, AmCham). The English mirrors of the Hungarian association sites (lang=eng) were inferred from URL patterns rather than confirmed, so EN/HU content parity is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the lang=eng variants of bankszovetseg.hu key pages and the /en/ trees of lizingszovetseg.hu, hunfintech.com, mabisz.hu and hvca.hu to establish which content exists in English for downstream EN-only pipelines.

coverage_gaps.description: The GVH decision search is a dynamic interface; whether full decision texts are downloadable as PDFs from result pages was not established, and no test query on a banking entity was executed.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a probe query with a known bank as 'eljárás alá vont', inspect the network calls for a JSON endpoint, and confirm PDF availability before designing the standing-query collector. Also evaluate the third-party mirror adatbazisok.hu as a fallback index.

coverage_gaps.description: Association member lists are published as current-state pages with no visible historical versions, so membership churn (entries, exits, mergers) cannot be reconstructed retrospectively from the sources themselves.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Begin quarterly snapshotting immediately for all member-list sources and, for backfill, query the Internet Archive Wayback Machine for bankszovetseg.hu/tagjaink, lizingszovetseg.hu and hunfintech.com/hu/tagok.

brief: Hungary's association layer is unusually well-suited to source seeding: Magyar Bankszövetség publishes an open, ~67-entry member directory with per-institution detail pages alongside a PDF report archive, and it is mirrored by sub-sector registers at Magyar Lízingszövetség (~36 members plus a statistics series back to 2000), Magyar Faktoring Szövetség, MAKISZ, MABISZ (whose Magyar Biztosítók Évkönyve is the closest thing to a true sector yearbook), HVCA and the Magyar Fintech Szövetség. Together these constitute a near-complete curated register of credible HU banks, leasing houses, factoring firms, insurers and fintech vendors, with IVSZ and AmCham adding the technology-supplier and foreign-branch actors the domestic bodies under-represent. The GVH decision archive (1997–2026, searchable by party and case number) is the strongest indirect-disclosure source in the cell, surfacing market-share and pricing detail from bank merger clearances that appears nowhere else. Main caveats: the Bankszövetség periodic sector report series appears to stop at 2018, and the two most valuable fintech/ICT member rosters (hunfintech.com, ivsz.hu) are likely JS-rendered and need a headless collector before they can be enumerated.
